claims.title: Spatial reaction diffusion: full physical gap, binary equilibrium and scoped all-time endpoint samplers

quoted_fields.interface: Fixed conservative complex-balanced local Theta=(reaction structure,kappa,c,positive conservation w,density R,positive diffusion delta_i), with state-preserving channels removed. Input is an explicit connected undirected simple graph G with n>=1 vertices, integer V>=1 and spatial population x0 with conserved mass<=R*nV. Original local rates are kappa_r V^(1-a_r)(x_v)_y and each oriented-edge diffusion rate is delta_i*x_vi. W=nV, A=max(1,max source/target arities). Actual classes are enabled-rule classes, not saturated fibres. For sampling/endpoint interfaces, volumes, populations, accuracy and physical time are binary inputs and all output/access/randomness costs are paid. Accepted E0C supplies fixed-local-network C0,D; DDB1 supplies fixed-structure all-activity inference and fixed two-species binomial draws.
quoted_fields.failure: Complete all-graph original-clock Poincare and spatial equilibrium-sampling operations, conditional only on already accepted E0C/DDB1 at their actual scopes. Graphs are connected, undirected, simple and homogeneous in the stated diffusion rates; local chemistry/species are fixed. The averaged totals generator is a stationary averaging identity, not the pathwise Markov law of aggregate transient counts. Early/late endpoint windows do not solve intermediate-time transition sampling. No continuum limit, practical simulation, general variable-dimensional counting theorem, independent proof replication or novelty/engineering claim. Source-read comparison papers do not supply the local nonlinear transient theorem. All known/unknown holds remain; RW math0512100v1 H3 is unread and no claim from it is imported. The one-to-one subcase uses independent particles. The subsequent Root operation handles source-unary branching by independent BOUNDED FAMILIES and exact projected linear propensities, with all source-unary channels retained; no extra impact score or independent high-impact replication is claimed. Original19F1 Section5 broader Ai->Aj comparison is INVALID for omitted unary splitting; its governing Root counterexample and complete repair supersede that assertion without altering the original capture. Generic finite-state complexity is polynomial in explicit S, not succinct state-space size. Fixed-M and polynomial numeric-V regimes have their stated parameter-dependent exponents; inverse-epsilon bounds are not accuracy-bit bounds. Full nonlinear transient and efficient Ehrenfest occupation clock are OPEN.
